attacks.name: Bolts of Flame
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Firestorm
steps: Allied characters within |!range| of this attack may remove 1 |!damage|.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Cosmically Empowered Telekinesis
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character of |!size| 5 or less or an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!movement_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Rejuvenating Flames
superPowers.body: Choose an allied character within |!range| 3. The chosen character removes up to 2 |!damage| and up to 1 special condition from itself. A character may be targeted by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Burning Resolve
superPowers.body: When another allied character within |!range| 3 would be Advanced, Placed, or Pushed by an enemy effect, this character may use this superpower. The allied character is not Advanced, Placed, or Pushed.

superPowers.name: I Am Fire and Life Incarnate
superPowers.body: Whenever an allied non-Grunt character is Dazed or KO'd, this character gains 1 |<phoenix>Phoenix| token. When this character would be Dazed, it gains 3 Phoenix tokens. If this character has 3 or more Phoenix tokens at the start of your Turn, or if this character would flip its Stat Card to the Injured side, Place |*Phoenix Unleashed| within |!range| 2 of it. |*Phoenix Unleashed| is now part of your Squad. Move all |!power|, all Activated tokens, and all Phoenix tokens from this character to |*Phoenix Unleashed|. Then, remove this character from the battlefield.

superPowers.name: Psionic Nexus
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

attacks.name: Phoenix Blast
steps: |*Destructive Force|: When creating the dice pool for this attack, this character may choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 2, 3, or 4 within |!range| 4 and destroy it. Add a number of dice to the attack pool equal to the |!size| of the terrain feature destroyed. Then, if there are fewer than 2 of this character's Flame Pillars in play, Place 1 Flame Pillar within |!range| 4 of this character. It is a |!size| 1 interactive terrain feature.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |<phoenix>Phoenix| token.

attacks.name: Molecular Disintegration
steps: After each attack is resolved, if the defender is not Dazed or KO'd, this character loses 1 Phoenix token.

superPowers.name: Temporal Domination
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it may use this superpower. This character gains 1 Phoenix token and may reroll up to 3 dice in its attack or defense roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: All Are Beneath Me
superPowers.body: When measuring the |!range| and LOS for this character's attacks, you may choose 1 of this character's Flame Pillars and measure |!range| and LOS from it. If you do, after all the attacks are resolved, each target character gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition. Then the chosen Flame Pillar is destroyed.

superPowers.name: Untamed Cosmic Entity
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power| for each Phoenix token it has. When this character Dazes or KO's an enemy character, this character loses 1 Phoenix token. When another allied non-Grunt character is Dazed or KO'd, this character gains 1 Phoenix token.|\|Additionally, if this character would flip its Stat Card to the Injured side, or if it has 5 or more Phoenix tokens at the end of its Activation, roll dice equal to the number of Phoenix tokens this character has. Each character within |!range| 5 of this character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| result rolled. Destroy each terrain feature within |!range| 5 of this character with a |!size| equal to or less than the number of |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| results rolled. Then this character is KO'd.

superPowers.name: Flight, Immune [Incinerate, Poison, Stagger, Stun], Peerless, Reserve

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 7 to 8 on Phoenix side, and from 10 to 13 on Phoenix Unleashed side.
Firestorm lost the "instead of suffering 1 |!damage|" text to grant the healing effect now that area attacks don't damage allied characters anymore.
